caption:
The video captures a hamster enclosure with wood-shaving bedding, a blue plastic tunnel at left, a purple water bottle on the dark back wall, two metal bowls behind a green wire exercise wheel, and a glass side wall on the right reflecting the tunnel and a bowl. Inside the wheel, two tan-and-white hamsters are already moving as the wheel turns, and that turning continues through the excerpt without a visible start.

At one stage, the wheel rotates quickly, blurring both hamsters and the green spokes as their bodies move around the circular frame. The blur then lessens, and the two hamsters appear close together near the lower part of the wheel. After that, the rotation becomes slower and more visible. One hamster remains on the left inner side, while the other moves along the right inner side. Their positions shift gradually, blur returns.

The background items hold fixed screen positions, so the visible change is the wheel and hamsters turning, not camera movement, throughout the clip.
relations: Wheel rotation carries the two hamsters around the green frame while bedding and tunnel remain fixed.
Faster turning blurs hamsters and spokes; slower turning reveals their shifting inner positions.
If rotation slows, one hamster can appear on the left inner side and the other on the right.
Glass side wall keeps reflecting the blue tunnel and a metal bowl as the wheel changes speed.
